assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished Korean daily economics editorial illustration. Reference image only for the exact brown otter character design and rich hand-painted cartoon rendering: round cream face and belly, small ears, black eyes/nose, whiskers, inquisitive expressive brows. New scene, not the oil/gold scene in reference. No logos, watermarks or text unless explicitly requested. Asset type: single portrait 2x2 four-panel comic, reading top-left top-right bottom-left bottom-right, clean thick black rounded borders, white gutters, readable large Korean lettering. Each panel has one speech bubble with EXACT given Korean text and the reference otter. Panel 1 otter surprised at an operational used oil tanker beside distant shipyard building a new tanker; speech: "지금 쓸 배가 더 비싸!" Panel 2 otter in warm coat points toward a container ship sailing arctic icy sea, speech: "다른 바닷길도 시험해!" Panel 3 otter looks at an empty freight container interior and clipboard, speech: "돌아올 때 실을 짐은?" Panel 4 otter checks raw materials stored in warehouse, speech: "원료 확보도 함께 준비!" No extra title, date, captions, panel numbers, charts or decorative text. Visual shows distinct oil tanker versus container ship accurately. Vibrant polished cartoon, 6:7 portrait ratio.
